# Clear Wave

> Clear Wave (App Store name: "Speaker Fix – Water Eject") is an iPhone and iPad app that ejects water and dust from speakers with tuned sound waves, then lets you verify the result with a stereo left/right test, a tone generator and a decibel meter.

## Key facts

- Product type: iOS utility app — water eject / speaker cleaner and speaker diagnostics
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742754087 (category: Music)
- Developer: Vladimir Ivakhnenko
- Devices: iPhone and iPad, requires iOS 17.1 or later
- Price: free download; optional in-app subscription (free trial) unlocks all tools
- Core tools: water eject / speaker cleaner, stereo test, tone generator, dB meter
- Languages: English + 30 more
- Privacy: App Store lists no data linked to the user's identity
